sync.title: Share through your Google account
sync.description: Sync settings, chats, statistics, and encrypted API keys across browsers on the same Google account. File attachments remain on the device.
sync.signed_in: Signed in to your Google account.
sync.signed_out: Signed out of your Google account.
sync.first_device_description: An end-to-end encrypted space will be created for this account. Save the recovery code shown on the next screen.
sync.recovery_required_description: Enter the recovery code from your first device so this browser can decrypt your data.
sync.save_recovery_description: This code is shown only now. Without it, you cannot link another browser.
sync.recovery_management_description: If this device is linked, you can create a new recovery code. Creating one invalidates any previous code.
sync.regenerate_recovery_confirm: Create a new recovery code? Any previous recovery code will become invalid.
sync.recovery_regenerated: A new recovery code was created. Store it somewhere safe.
sync.auto_sync_note: Your changes are sent within a minute. Automatic sync does not run while the panel is closed.
sync.auto_sync_off_note: Automatic sync is off; only "Sync now" runs.
sync.auto_sync_slow: Quota guard: automatic sync slowed down because today's usage passed 50%.
sync.blocked_until: Firebase quota protection is active until {{date}}.
sync.attachments_local_notice: Binary content for images, PDFs, Office files, and screen crops is never uploaded. Other devices receive attachment metadata only.
sync.cloud_temporarily_unavailable_title: Google sign-in succeeded; cloud sync is temporarily unavailable
sync.google_session_preserved: Your Google session remains signed in. Local data is unaffected and pending changes are preserved.
sync.device_disabled_notice: This device was turned off from another device. Sync stays stopped until it is turned back on; chats and settings remain on this device.
sync.legacy_cleanup_description: Permanently removes encrypted attachments, revisions, and unused cloud backups uploaded by earlier versions. Current chats and settings are not touched.
sync.legacy_cleanup_confirm: Permanently delete legacy encrypted attachments, revisions, and unused cloud backups? This cannot be undone.
sync.backup_description: Export chats, settings, statistics, and API keys to a file that can only be read with this account's key.

errors.sync_failed: Synchronization could not be completed. Retry later.

prompts.summarize_context: Summarize and relate the attached files and public web pages.
prompts.ocr: Extract only the visible text from the attached image or images. Do not add explanations, summaries, translations, interpretations, or any text that is not visible. Preserve headings, paragraphs, lists, line order, and reading order as closely as possible. Mark every unreadable section as [unreadable]. If there is more than one image, process them in attachment order and separate the results with the headings Image 1, Image 2 and so on.
